name: Andorra Family Dentistry
description: A Philadelphia family dental practice offering checkups, cleanings, and restorative care for patients of all ages.

hero.headline: Andorra Family Dentistry
hero.sub: Checkups, cleanings, and restorative care for every member of the family, in one practice.

items: Routine exams and cleanings for kids, adults, and everyone in between
Restorative dentistry including fillings and crowns
Preventive guidance tailored to each patient’s age and needs
A family practice serving the Philadelphia community
New patients of all ages welcome
Treatment plans explained clearly before any work begins
A comfortable office built for repeat family visits

story.heading: About
paragraphs: Andorra Family Dentistry treats patients across every age group, from a child’s first cleaning to routine adult care.
The practice leans on prevention first, so appointments stay simple and small issues do not become bigger ones.

items: Book an appointment for any member of the family under one roof.
Treatment plans are reviewed with you before anything is scheduled.
A calm, modern office designed for patients of every age.

feature.heading: One practice for the whole family
feature.text: From a first child’s checkup to routine adult cleanings, care is scoped to the patient in the chair.

spotlight.heading: Restorative care when it is needed
spotlight.text: Fillings, crowns, and other restorative work are explained plainly before any treatment starts.
